title: Independently verify published Math Expression NuGet package and its exact published Quantities dependency
commitMessage: test: verify published Expression NuGet binary and exact base closure

contribution.summary: Independently verify both locally published dw.quantities.expression and dw.quantities immutable NuGet packages, their one exact dependency and a fresh source-free six-case binary consumer.
contribution.value: Read exact shared-feed SHA-256 archive and DLL bytes, validate a two-package snapshot using Dw.Tools.NuGet, restore Expression with one exact PackageReference and execute six independent binary checks without republishing.
debtChanges: Operator-published Expression passed its direct --verify; RS140 adds independent DWF evidence against actual physical shared-feed bytes without changing prior qualification receipts.
The complete local mixed NuGet feed is not scanned; only two explicit immutable archives and their exact transitive dependency are within the verified scope.
Public NuGet publication, license selection, installed package rollback, other OS/RID compatibility and Discovery admission remain unqualified.
dw.quantities.standard must receive its own candidate, exact two-package dependency graph, binary tests and separate private publication authorization.
RS140 retry 1 restores the missing typed JSON Read helper in the independent verifier after a pre-attempt CS0103 refusal. No attempt was allocated; first-pass is NO.
contribution.nextAction: After RS140 succeeds, qualify dw.quantities.standard using exact calendar PackageReferences for its published base and Expression dependencies; preserve source versions and test 250 g = 1/4 kg without any implicit release.
